Бенциклана Фумарат C19H31NO,C4H4O4 = 405.5. CAS — 2179-37-5 (bencyclane); 14286-84-1 (bencyclane fumarate). ATC — C04AX11. ATC Vet — QC04AX11. (bencyclane) Profile Bencyclane fumarate is a vasodilator used in the management of peripheral (p.1178) and cerebral vascular disorders (p.1165) in usual oral doses of 100 to 200 mg three times daily. It has also been given intravenously. Bencyclane acefyllinate has also been used.
